x: First there was Pamich of Italy (what a wonderful stylist he is) then Dordini (again a brilliant walker) and Soderlund of Sweden - they all went by and I couldn't do a thing about it, in fact I'd have given anything to lay down in the gutter for an hour or so.

Italy, after a great start in which Pamich beat Olympic winner Don Thompson by as much as five minutes in the 50 kilometre failed to stay the course and put up a comparatively poor showing in the shorter events.

This was an excellent performance in a truly world class field in which the great Pamich could only finish 3rd. Ray's old rival, Don Thompson, walked his best race since pre-illness days to finish 4th.

Wilf Wesch walked a powerful 30 Kilo Leg for Young England holding Pamich to two minutes and in the 100 Kilometres Pat Duncan pulled back six minutes on last year for a personal best 10:15:00 catching world champion Hohne, nearly ?
To go to the head of the field and win the race and to be acclaimed with the names of Whitlock, Baker, Thompson, Pamich, Middleton is something extra.
